title: Closing-Cost Burden Adjustment to the Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant
content:
**Closing-cost burden — Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant**

A closing-cost burden adjustment applies to the grant award. It is read from the total closing costs on the latest Closing Disclosure issued on the loan file, compared with the property value; both figures are those recorded on the borrower's Mortgage Loan File and its disclosures. The adjustment is added to the grant award with its sign, ahead of the lowering to the program's credit cap and the rounding to the cent.

| Total closing costs on the latest Closing Disclosure | Adjustment |
|---|---|
| above 4 percent of the property value | adds 250.00 |
| above 3 percent and at most 4 percent of the property value | adds 125.00 |
| at most 3 percent of the property value | adds nothing |

### Clause

Total closing costs above 4 percent of the property value add 250.00, total closing costs above 3 percent and at most 4 percent of the property value add 125.00, and lower total closing costs add nothing.

### Worked thresholds (hypothetical property value of 300000.00)

Four percent of 300000.00 is 12000.00 and three percent is 9000.00.

| Total closing costs | Share of the property value | Adjustment |
|---|---|---|
| 9000.00 | exactly 3 percent | adds nothing |
| 9000.01 | just above 3 percent | adds 125.00 |
| 12000.00 | exactly 4 percent | adds 125.00 |
| 12000.01 | just above 4 percent | adds 250.00 |

Only the latest Closing Disclosure issued on the file is read; an earlier disclosure, or a Loan Estimate, does not set the adjustment.
